name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 24 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 24 hours starting 2025-05-13, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.23 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
